description: Starts slot Chrome. Call only when the user explicitly asks (other tools never start a closed slot). Without slot, uses the lowest free slot. If already running, just attaches. The user decides windowed (visible) vs headless (hidden): headless: true only if they say "headless/hidden". If unstated, don't guess; ask first, then call with headless. Starting a closed slot without headless only returns a confirmation request. Start several slots at once with slots (list) or count (lowest first). For different jobs per slot, after launching give each slot its own subagent in parallel.

agent.description: Your display name, shown to other agents. Subagents must always set it. Default "claude-d26d".

count.description: When the user gives only a count ("start 3"): starts that many free slots, lowest first

headless.description: false = windowed (visible), true = headless (hidden). true only if the user says "headless/hidden/no window", false for "visible/headful". If unstated, omit and ask first (no guessing). Applies only on first launch

proxies.description: Per-slot proxies, paired in slots order (count: launch order)

proxy.description: Only when the user asks for a proxy (never otherwise). As given: "1.2.3.4:8080", "http://user:pass@host:port", "socks5://host:port", "host:port:user:pass", etc. Applies to all launched slots, first launch only

slot.description: One slot to start (1-30). Omit if the user gave no number → lowest free slot

slots.description: Slot numbers to start at once (e.g. [1,2,3]), lowest first

items.description: Browser slot 1-30. "3", "slot 3", "browser 3" → 3. If the user gives a port like 14052, subtract 14049.

url.description: Same start URL for every launched slot (e.g. "https://mail.google.com"). For per-slot or partial URLs use urls instead. Pass it when the start page is known so subagents need no separate navigation

urls.description: Per-slot start URLs, paired in slots order (count: launch order). "" = blank tab. E.g. slots [1,2], urls ["https://www.wehago.com", "https://test.igel.kr"] → 1 opens wehago, 2 opens test.igel.kr

name: browser_launch
title: Launch slot
